lines.zh: 它离地半寸滑行，脚下没有脚印
lines.en: It glides an inch off the ground, leaving no prints.

lines.zh: 幽光在它身后拖成一道淡痕
lines.en: A pale glow trails behind it like a thin scar.

lines.zh: 它飘过密室长廊，灯随之变暗
lines.en: It drifts down the chamber hall, and the lamps dim.

lines.zh: 长袍下什么也没有，只有光
lines.en: Beneath its robe there is nothing but light.

lines.zh: 它绕过石柱，没有带起一点风
lines.en: It passes the pillar without stirring any air.

lines.zh: 走起来时，剑影在它身侧晃动
lines.en: As it floats, a sword's shadow sways beside it.

lines.zh: 它沿着密室的纹路慢慢移过去
lines.en: It follows the chamber's carved lines at a drift.

lines.zh: 半透明的身体穿过垂下的锁链
lines.en: Its half-seen body slips through the hanging chains.

lines.zh: 它每走一段，光就淡一层
lines.en: Every stretch it drifts, its glow fades a shade.

lines.zh: 它无声地滑过积了灰的地砖
lines.en: It slides silently over the dusty floor tiles.

lines.zh: 它悬在半空，剑尖始终朝下
lines.en: It hovers with the sword tip always pointing down.

lines.zh: 幽光一收一放，像在呼吸
lines.en: The glow swells and dims, almost like breathing.

lines.zh: 密室的火把被它的光压得很低
lines.en: The chamber torches burn low under its glow.

lines.zh: 它抬头看着天花板上的刻纹
lines.en: It looks up at the carvings on the ceiling.

lines.zh: 剑身的纹路与它身上的光同步闪动
lines.en: The sword's etchings pulse in time with its glow.

lines.zh: 它静静等着，像在等剑召唤
lines.en: It waits quietly, as if for the sword to call.

lines.zh: 地上的影子比它本体先动一下
lines.en: Its shadow on the floor moves before it does.

lines.zh: 它把自己收得很淡，几乎看不见
lines.en: It thins its own light until it is barely seen.

lines.zh: 剑柄朝上，浮在它胸前不动
lines.en: A sword hilt floats motionless before its chest.

lines.zh: 它对密室的每块砖都很熟悉
lines.en: It knows every brick of this chamber by heart.

lines.zh: 幽光落在墙上，照出一柄巨剑的影
lines.en: Its glow throws a great sword's shadow on the wall.

lines.zh: 它一动不动，像被钉在了空气里
lines.en: It hangs utterly still, as if pinned in the air.

lines.zh: 有风穿过，它的轮廓晃了晃
lines.en: A draft passes through, and its outline wavers.

lines.zh: 它把手按在剑上，光从指缝漏出
lines.en: It rests a hand on the blade, and light leaks through.

lines.zh: 我把剑横在膝上，等一个名字。
lines.en: I lay the sword across my knees and wait for a name.

lines.zh: 密室的门开着，我不去关。
lines.en: The chamber door stands open; I leave it that way.

lines.zh: 它转过头，光在脸上聚成眼睛
lines.en: It turns, and light gathers into eyes on its face.

lines.zh: 你站在门口，它已经看了你许久
lines.en: You stand at the doorway, and it has watched a while.

lines.zh: 它抬手指向剑身，像在问你来意
lines.en: It points at the blade, as if asking your purpose.

lines.zh: 幽光在你脸上投下一层淡青
lines.en: Its glow casts a pale cyan light across your face.

lines.zh: 它认出你手里的剑，退了半步
lines.en: It recognizes the sword in your hand and steps back.

lines.zh: 它从剑后看你，只露出半张脸
lines.en: It peers from behind the sword, half a face showing.

lines.zh: 那双眼睛没有瞳孔，只是两团光
lines.en: Those eyes have no pupils, just two pools of light.

lines.zh: 它在打量你，也在打量你的锋刃
lines.en: It studies you, and studies your blade as well.

lines.zh: 你一动，它的光就亮了一度
lines.en: When you move, its glow brightens a notch.

lines.zh: 它飘近半步，寒气贴着地面过来
lines.en: It drifts closer, and chill creeps along the floor.

lines.zh: 它盯着墙上自己的影子，又看看你
lines.en: It looks at its own shadow, then back at you.

lines.zh: 你举起幽光剑，它的表情才变了
lines.en: Only when you raise Spectralibur does its face change.

lines.zh: 剑影散了一下，又慢慢凝回原样
lines.en: The shadow scatters, then slowly knits back together.

lines.zh: 它被击中处透出更亮的光
lines.en: The struck spot shines brighter than the rest.

lines.zh: 它没有血，只是光暗了半层
lines.en: There is no blood, only half its glow gone.

lines.zh: 这一下让它退了半尺，剑却没落
lines.en: The blow sets it back a foot, but the sword holds.

lines.zh: 它低头看伤口，那里正在合拢
lines.en: It looks at the wound, which is closing over.

lines.zh: 它的轮廓抖了一下，随即稳住
lines.en: Its outline wavers once, then steadies.

lines.zh: 空气里多了一股烧焦的味道
lines.en: A smell of scorched air hangs around it.

lines.zh: 被击中时，它发出很轻的叹息
lines.en: When struck, it lets out a very soft sigh.

lines.zh: 它的光被削掉一角，很快补回
lines.en: A corner of its light is cut away and regrows.

lines.zh: 它没有退，只把剑握得更紧
lines.en: It does not retreat; it grips the sword tighter.

lines.zh: 它不要食物，只看你的剑
lines.en: It wants no food, only your sword.

lines.zh: 递过去的东西直接穿过了它
lines.en: What you offer passes straight through it.

lines.zh: 它对你的面包看都不看
lines.en: It does not spare a glance for your bread.

lines.zh: 它伸手越过食物，指向你的剑柄
lines.en: Its hand reaches past the food, toward your hilt.

lines.zh: 你把剑收回，它的光立刻暗了
lines.en: You sheath the sword, and its glow dims at once.

lines.zh: 它对地上的东西毫无反应
lines.en: It shows no reaction to anything on the ground.

lines.zh: 有东西穿过它的身体，落在地上
lines.en: The item passes through its body and hits the floor.

lines.zh: 它只对幽光有反应，别的都不理
lines.en: It responds to the spectral glow and to nothing else.

lines.zh: 你把食物放在密室中央，它绕开了
lines.en: You set food in the chamber's center, and it goes around.

lines.zh: 它偏向你手里的剑，嗓音低了下去
lines.en: It leans toward your blade and lowers its voice.

lines.zh: 你撞进它身体，只感到一阵凉
lines.en: You pass into its body and feel only cold.

lines.zh: 它被撞得散开，又慢慢聚回来
lines.en: The bump scatters it, and it slowly gathers again.

lines.zh: 剑影穿过你，什么也没碰到
lines.en: The sword's shadow passes through you, touching nothing.

lines.zh: 相碰的瞬间，它的光泼了你一身
lines.en: At contact, its glow spills all over you.

lines.zh: 它退开一点，把轮廓重新收紧
lines.en: It draws back and tightens its outline again.

lines.zh: 你撞过的地方浮着一层薄雾
lines.en: A thin mist hangs where you struck it.

lines.zh: 它侧身让开，身体被你自己穿过
lines.en: It turns aside and lets you pass right through it.

lines.zh: 碰撞后它亮了一下，随即又灭了
lines.en: After the collision it flares once, then dims.

lines.zh: 你撞在剑上，剑身震得发烫
lines.en: You hit the blade itself, and it pulses warm.

lines.zh: 它不躲避，只把光调亮了一些
lines.en: It does not dodge, only brightens its glow a little.

lines.zh: 密室只有它一个，剑也只一把
lines.en: The chamber holds one of it, and one blade.

lines.zh: 它不需要同类，只需要剑的召唤
lines.en: It needs no kin, only the sword's summons.

lines.zh: 若有第二道幽光，它就消散了
lines.en: Should a second glow appear, it would dissolve.

lines.zh: 它曾与一柄剑定下约定
lines.en: It once made a pact with a single blade.

lines.zh: 漫长的等待里，它没有别的事
lines.en: In the long wait, it has nothing else to do.

lines.zh: 它把轮廓贴向剑影，像在拥抱
lines.en: It leans its shape to the sword's shadow, embracing.

lines.zh: 密室的回音里没有回应它的声音
lines.en: The chamber's echo returns no answer to it.

lines.zh: 它守着那把剑，比守着伴侣久
lines.en: It has guarded that blade longer than any mate.

lines.zh: 剑在，它就在；剑断，它便走
lines.en: While the blade lasts it stays; broken, it departs.

lines.zh: 它与剑相伴，年数已经数不清
lines.en: It has kept the blade company past counting.

lines.zh: 掉落的东西穿过它，落在地上
lines.en: A dropped item slips through it to the floor.

lines.zh: 它没有实体，捡不起任何东西
lines.en: It has no substance and cannot lift a thing.

lines.zh: 它看了一眼地上的剑鞘，走开了
lines.en: It glances at the fallen scabbard and moves on.

lines.zh: 有东西滚来，它伸手却什么也没碰到
lines.en: Something rolls over, and its hand closes on nothing.

lines.zh: 它只在乎剑，别的都落在身后
lines.en: It cares only for the blade and leaves the rest behind.

lines.zh: 你丢出的物品被它的光染成淡青
lines.en: Its glow tints the item you threw a pale cyan.

lines.zh: 东西掉进它身体，又从另一边出来
lines.en: The item falls into its body and out the far side.

lines.zh: 它试着托起剑鞘，手指穿了过去
lines.en: It tries to lift the scabbard, and its fingers pass through.

lines.zh: 它对地上的战利品毫无兴趣
lines.en: It has no interest in the loot on the floor.

lines.zh: 那把剑不在手里，它便什么也不碰
lines.en: With no blade in hand, it touches nothing.

lines.zh: 你握住剑柄，它立刻转向你
lines.en: You grip the hilt, and it turns at once.

lines.zh: 它的光猛地一亮，认定了你
lines.en: Its glow flares hard, and it settles on you.

lines.zh: 剑尖抬起，指向你的胸口
lines.en: The sword tip rises, pointing at your chest.

lines.zh: 密室的灯全灭了，只剩它的光
lines.en: Every lamp in the chamber dies, and only it glows.

lines.zh: 它不问缘由，只当你来夺剑
lines.en: It asks nothing and takes you for a thief.

lines.zh: 那团幽光收紧，凝成长矛的形状
lines.en: The glow contracts into the shape of a lance.

lines.zh: 它缓慢漂来，房间一下冷了几度
lines.en: It drifts in slowly, and the room turns colder.

lines.zh: 你退到门口，它已经挡在那里
lines.en: You back to the doorway, and it is already there.

lines.zh: 剑影分裂成两道，一起朝向你
lines.en: The sword's shadow splits in two, both facing you.

lines.zh: 它的身体开始涨大，撑满整条走廊
lines.en: Its body swells until it fills the whole corridor.

lines.zh: 它低头看你，像在看一件旧物
lines.en: It looks down at you like an old possession.

lines.zh: 它锁定了你，光也随之一路跟来
lines.en: It locks on, and its light follows you along.

lines.zh: 剑身上的刻纹亮起，它开始认真
lines.en: Etchings on the blade light up, and it grows serious.

lines.zh: 你踏进密室中心，它才动手
lines.en: Only when you reach the center does it act.

lines.zh: 你一开口，剑就替你答了。
lines.en: You speak, and the sword answers for you.

lines.zh: 我抬起剑，光顺刃口爬向你。
lines.en: I raise the blade and light crawls down its edge toward you.

lines.zh: 密室认得活人，我认得你。
lines.en: The chamber knows the living; I know you.

lines.zh: 你把手放在石门上，我醒了。
lines.en: You lay your hand on the stone door, and I wake.

lines.zh: 它飘在你身后，不加快也不放慢
lines.en: It drifts behind you, neither faster nor slower.

lines.zh: 你转过走廊，它已在前方等着
lines.en: You round the hall, and it already waits ahead.

lines.zh: 长矛的形态稳定下来，正对着你
lines.en: The lance form steadies and aims at you.

lines.zh: 它追得不急，因为密室只有一个出口
lines.en: It hardly hurries, since the chamber has one exit.

lines.zh: 它的光贴着地面追，像一条线
lines.en: Its glow chases along the floor like a thread.

lines.zh: 你砸碎一扇门，它从碎口飘进来
lines.en: You break a door, and it drifts through the gap.

lines.zh: 无论你走哪条道，它都等在前面
lines.en: Whichever path you take, it waits ahead.

lines.zh: 它的影子先一步压过墙角
lines.en: Its shadow reaches the corner before it does.

lines.zh: 你听见铁链轻响，它就在近处
lines.en: You hear the chains whisper: it is close now.

lines.zh: 它把光收拢成一条窄线追来
lines.en: It narrows its glow to a thin line and follows.

lines.zh: 你躲进侧室，门缝里透进幽光
lines.en: You duck into a side room, and glow seeps under the door.

lines.zh: 它在追，却不发出一点声音
lines.en: It gives chase without making a single sound.

lines.zh: 你跑过的地砖，光一盏盏亮起
lines.en: The tiles you cross light up one by one.

lines.zh: 它停在楼梯口，等你走上来
lines.en: It stops at the stairwell and waits for you to climb.

lines.zh: 你跑过三间空室，我一直在。
lines.en: You pass three empty rooms; I am always there.

lines.zh: 我隔着墙也能看见你的光。
lines.en: I can see your light even through the walls.

lines.zh: 剑尖拖在地上，划出一条线。
lines.en: The tip drags on the floor and draws a line.

lines.zh: 你拐弯，我提前到了那头。
lines.en: You turn a corner; I am already at the far end.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸在长廊里太清楚。
lines.en: Your breathing is far too clear in this corridor.

lines.zh: 密室的尽头只有墙，我等着。
lines.en: This chamber ends in a wall, and I wait there.

lines.zh: 剑影劈下，你的护甲上结了一层霜
lines.en: The sword's shadow falls, and frost coats your armor.

lines.zh: 它用长矛直刺，速度比看上去快
lines.en: It thrusts the lance faster than it looks.

lines.zh: 一击过后，你的视野暗了一瞬
lines.en: After the blow, your sight goes dark for a moment.

lines.zh: 剑影掠过，地上的灰被吹开
lines.en: The shadow sweeps by and blows the dust aside.

lines.zh: 它的巨影一步压来，地面陷了下去
lines.en: Its huge form steps in, and the floor gives way.

lines.zh: 你被那股寒气逼退，剑都握不稳
lines.en: The chill drives you back, and you barely hold your blade.

lines.zh: 它抬手一挥，光刃贴着你的肩过去
lines.en: It waves a hand, and a light blade grazes your shoulder.

lines.zh: 这一击没有血肉，只有刺骨的冷
lines.en: No flesh, no blood, only a piercing cold.

lines.zh: 它的长矛收回时，空气才重新流动
lines.en: Air only moves again once the lance withdraws.

lines.zh: 剑影分裂成三道，同时斩下
lines.en: The shadow splits into three and cuts at once.

lines.zh: 它撞过来时带着一整面墙的影
lines.en: It charges in with a whole wall of shadow.

lines.zh: 你举起盾，光刃在上面留了一道白痕
lines.en: You raise your shield, and the blade leaves a white line.

lines.zh: 它一击落空，光在墙上炸开
lines.en: Its strike misses, and light bursts on the wall.

lines.zh: 每次攻击后，它都要重新凝形
lines.en: After each attack it must gather its shape again.

lines.zh: 剑身一颤，幽光从刃口流了出来
lines.en: The blade trembles, and spectral light pours from its edge.

lines.zh: 密室中央的地纹亮起，它从中升起
lines.en: The chamber's floor runes glow, and it rises through them.

lines.zh: 剑被拔出的一瞬，走廊尽头亮了
lines.en: The moment the sword is drawn, the hall's end lights up.

lines.zh: 光聚成一个人的轮廓，慢慢立起
lines.en: Light gathers into a person's outline and slowly stands.

lines.zh: 它先有剑，然后才有身体
lines.en: First comes the sword, and only then the body.

lines.zh: 沉睡的密室中，一层薄光浮起
lines.en: In the sleeping chamber, a thin glow lifts.

lines.zh: 剑柄落地，幽光散开又收拢
lines.en: The hilt hits the floor, and the glow scatters and gathers.

lines.zh: 它从墙上的剑影里走了出来
lines.en: It steps out of the sword's shadow on the wall.

lines.zh: 空气忽然变冷，它就在你面前成形
lines.en: The air turns cold, and it forms before you.

lines.zh: 那一瞬间，密室的每盏灯同时灭了
lines.en: In that instant, every lamp in the chamber dies at once.

lines.zh: 它由一段旧誓约凝成，缓缓睁眼
lines.en: Forged from an old oath, it slowly opens its eyes.

lines.zh: 剑刃上浮出一道同样长的光
lines.en: A second blade of light rises above the steel.

lines.zh: 它浮现时，锁链全被震得轻响
lines.en: As it appears, all the chains ring softly.

lines.zh: 幽光密室深处，一柄剑立了起来
lines.en: Deep in the glow chamber, a sword stands upright.

lines.zh: 剑鞘空了，我从空处站起来。
lines.en: The sheath is empty; I rise out of the emptiness.

lines.zh: 有人在外头举起了那把剑。
lines.en: Someone out there has raised the sword.

lines.zh: 我由一道旧光凝成，先有手。
lines.en: I condense from an old light, hands first.

lines.zh: 密室顶上的刻纹一起亮起。
lines.en: The carvings overhead light up all at once.

lines.zh: 你听见剑鸣，我已在你身后。
lines.en: You hear the sword sing; I am already behind you.

lines.zh: 锁链自己让开，给我腾出位置。
lines.en: The chains draw aside and make room for me.

lines.zh: 火焰穿过它的身体，只让光更亮
lines.en: Fire passes through its body and only brightens it.

lines.zh: 它落地时几乎无声，只有光晃了晃
lines.en: It lands almost silently, with only its glow swaying.

lines.zh: 水淹上来，它的光在水下变得浑浊
lines.en: Water rises, and its glow turns murky below.

lines.zh: 爆炸把它吹散，光点慢慢往回聚
lines.en: The blast scatters it, and its sparks slowly return.

lines.zh: 箭穿过它，钉在身后的墙上
lines.en: The arrow passes through and sticks in the wall.

lines.zh: 法术打在它身上，两股光互相抵消
lines.en: The spell hits, and two glows cancel each other out.

lines.zh: 失去剑的滋养，它的光一点点变淡
lines.en: Without the sword's nurture, its glow thins away.

lines.zh: 雷电劈中它，整间密室都亮成白色
lines.en: Lightning strikes it, and the whole chamber goes white.

lines.zh: 虚空里，它的光被拉成长长一条
lines.en: In the void, its glow is stretched into a long thread.
